description: This file manages dependencies for Playwright, including functions for installing dependencies on Windows and Linux, checking system dependencies, handling Docker versions, and utility functions for executing commands and checking shared libraries. It also includes platform-specific logic and error handling related to browser dependencies.

methods.name: writeDockerVersion
methods.description: Writes Docker version info to a file, creating directories as needed and setting permissions.

methods.name: dockerVersion
methods.description: Generates Docker image name with current version info.

methods.name: readDockerVersionSync
methods.description: Reads Docker version info from a file synchronously.

methods.name: installDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Installs Windows dependencies for specified browser groups, e.g., Chromium.

methods.name: installDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Installs Linux dependencies for specified browser groups, handling package installation.

methods.name: validateDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Checks for missing Windows system dependencies and provides guidance.

methods.name: validateDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Checks for missing Linux dependencies and suggests installation commands.
